flashcards.q: How is chat used in AI Tools And Platforms?
flashcards.a: AI Tools and Platforms maps the landscape of AI products a revenue team can use, from chat assistants to APIs, and teaches how to choose between them on capability, cost, data handling and integration effort.
A chat assistant is an application where a person types questions and gets answers, useful for one-off drafting and research.

flashcards.q: When is requests applied in AI Tools And Platforms?
flashcards.a: A tool that looks cheap per seat can become expensive when automated workflows run thousands of requests a day.

flashcards.q: When should vendor not be used in AI Tools And Platforms?
flashcards.a: When comparing tools, test them on your own tasks, not on vendor demos.

flashcards.q: Where does customer data come up in AI Tools And Platforms?
flashcards.a: Every new tool adds a login, a cost and a place where customer data lives.

flashcards.q: Which approach to score fits AI Tools And Platforms?
flashcards.a: Score at least three options against the same test set.

flashcards.q: Who is involved with chat in AI Tools And Platforms?
flashcards.a: AI Tools and Platforms maps the landscape of AI products a revenue team can use, from chat assistants to APIs, and teaches how to choose between them on capability, cost, data handling and integration effort.

flashcards.q: How is scorecard used in AI Tools And Platforms?
flashcards.a: Build a test set of ten real examples, run them through three tools, score the results on a shared scorecard, and write a one-page recommendation with cost per month at your expected volume.

flashcards.q: What does AI Tools And Platforms teach about provider?
flashcards.a: Foundation models are general models offered by a provider and used for many tasks.

flashcards.q: When is shelfware applied in AI Tools And Platforms?
flashcards.a: Buying a tool before defining the problem leads to shelfware.

flashcards.q: Which approach to choose fits AI Tools And Platforms?
flashcards.a: Choose one task, such as summarizing sales calls.

flashcards.q: Who is involved with per-seat licences in AI Tools And Platforms?
flashcards.a: Pricing usually combines per-seat licences for people and per-token usage for automation.

flashcards.q: What does AI Tools And Platforms teach about your?
flashcards.a: Open-weight models are models whose trained weights can be downloaded and run on your own infrastructure.

flashcards.q: Who is involved with customer data in AI Tools And Platforms?
flashcards.a: Every new tool adds a login, a cost and a place where customer data lives.

flashcards.q: What does AI Tools And Platforms teach about answers?
flashcards.a: A company that keeps a test set of real tasks with known good answers can compare any new model in an afternoon and move when the numbers justify it.

flashcards.q: What does AI Tools And Platforms teach about customer data?
flashcards.a: Read how customer data is used before any real data is sent.
